blocks.md: Software benchmarks in machine learning frequently report latency as isolated accelerator execution time, for example … for the vision backbone of the arm's wrist-camera grasp path on an edge neural processing unit (NPU), a different pipeline from the navigation backbone that the stopping budget of a later section charges. This narrow focus fosters the illusion of an agile … control loop. In physical AI systems, however, that compute kernel represents only one intermediate segment in an end-to-end silicon-to-plant dataflow pipeline.

questions.q: The section **Measurement Freshness** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Gear compliance and backlash put lost motion and limit cycles between motor and load, so measured motor position is not the load's position.

An observation's age runs from physical transduction to actuator torque onset and must stay under the freshness deadline E_max / v_max set by the target's speed and the spatial tolerance, with inference only one of many stages.

Before torque reaches a winding the permission path must find non-negative margin in all five physical budgets at once (observation age, stopping distance, deliverable torque, winding temperature, supply), because one budget's slack never pays another's deficit.
Every physical value carries one of five evidence categories (measured, derived, datasheet, illustrative, chosen), which decides how far an admission decision may rely on it.
